    • patientIdQueryParameters

      protected Set<String> patientIdQueryParameters()
      The search parameters that name the patient a query is about. The server side does not need them: it gets the request parsed into FhirSearchParameters, which knows its own patient parameter. The client side has only the query string it sent, so the names have to be spelled out.

      These are the ones the patient-centric FHIR query transactions use. A transaction whose patient lives somewhere else overrides this.

      Returns:
      names of the search parameters that carry a patient id

    • enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse

      public boolean enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse(FhirQueryAuditDataset auditDataset, Object response, AuditContext auditContext)
      Fills in the patient from the query string, for the client side.

      This runs here rather than in enrichAuditDatasetFromRequest(FhirQueryAuditDataset, Object, Map) because the query string does not exist yet when that is called: the client audit dataset only learns it once HAPI has built the request, which happens on the way out. Without it a client record could never name the patient, and would be stepped down to a weaker profile than the server record of the same transaction.

      Specified by:
      enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse in interface AuditStrategy<FhirQueryAuditDataset>
      Overrides:
      enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse in class AbstractFhirAuditStrategy<FhirQueryAuditDataset, IBaseOperationOutcome>
      Parameters:
      auditDataset - audit dataset
      response - response object
      auditContext - audit context
      Returns:
      whether the transaction is to be considered successful
